Nov 2023 • Couples
We were in Vietnam for two weeks and the food here at „la Maison“ was delicious and one of the best places where we have eaten. We order a Menu and all the courses were very good and Served one After another and Not all at once as it is usual here. The personal is fantastic and was all the time looking that Eveything is ok. 
The ambient and the local is also very Nice. I would definetly recommend this place. The best dish was probably the mushroom soup with truffel. 
It is not neccesary to Travel to France, the food here was on the same Level, really exquisite.

French fusion at it s finest
Mar 2019 • Couples
So I went to this restaurant last night with high expectations as I am French and I was craving comfort food from home. This place hit all the right notes ! I was looking primarily for a romantic atmosphere and this place totally delivered !! On top of that there is a live singer, she was so good we thought it was a recording at first but it turned out to be live music !!!

Food was exquisite ! I had the pan seared foie gras --> tasted just like home damn ! ordered some Cotes du Rhone on the side, recommended by the waiter. It was great balance with the food. Also I finished with a home made dessert "creme caramel" ; nothing fancy but the taste was simply perfect.

I highly recommend this place if you're looking for something nice to celebrate or just to have your french food fix. I will definitely return !
